text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? Ines, you're on the morning shift today too~?
Seriously, what are the odds we've been running into each other lately~?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: I mean, my boyfriend told me... Ines was working another part-time job somewhere else—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~, you betcha!
I've even taken on some new part-time shifts.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, shoot! I have to get to school!
Let's talk more next time we're on shift together!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: ......Oh~. Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Final adjustments heading into the Kikuka Sho.
As for how Ines Fujin is looking—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
Kgh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression remained tense.
That stifled strain was reflected in her lap times as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A mediocre time, far from her personal best. From trying too hard to hold herself back, her form had stiffened completely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If this awkwardness continues, it might impact her future as well.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You don't have to force yourself to hold it in.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I truly care for her body,
I have a strong desire to have her grasp a new way of running
before challenging the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, on the flip side, if taking on the challenge was forcing her too hard, reverting to her previous running style is also an option.
choice_data_list: I'll back you up to make up for it.
I'll back you up to make up for it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
......I'm fine, totally fine!
I'd rather you believe in me than worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna prove to my family too
that I'm their big sis who's totally fine,
no matter how fierce the race was!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Because those girls are sure to be watching too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Kikuka Sho.
As if trying to keep her surging emotions in check,
Ines Fujin kept her eyes closed tight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
! A phone call...?
Huh, isn't this number...?

text_block_list.name: Workplace Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Hello? Is this Ines Fujin?
Where are you right now?"

text_block_list.name: Workplace Staff
text_block_list.text: "Since today is our first day on site, I wanted to give a brief orientation. But it seems you weren't at the meeting spot..."

text_block_list.name: Workplace Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Hellooo?
Is this Ines Fujin-san's number?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!
I'm so sorry! I...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking over for Ines Fujin, whose face is rapidly
turning pale, I speak to the person on the phone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sorting out the details, it seems she accidentally
double-booked her schedule with her new part-time job."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, they profusely apologized to the other party,
and were able to handle the matter without it
becoming a major issue.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry, Trainer.
I messed up...”
choice_data_list: Ines, it's going to be okay.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nothing like this has ever happened before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tell her that I'll explain the situation to her part-time job as well, ensuring Ines Fujin won't have to shoulder all the blame alone.
choice_data_list: Take a deep breath and focus on the race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Show everyone how fun running is for you.
Show everyone how fun running is for you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah... You're right.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: At the very least, I have to make up for this mistake in the race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Following after her as she rushed out
of the waiting room, I step outside as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't leave her alone right now.
At the very least, I'll wave to her from the edge of the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In hopes of being of help to her, even just a little—
